description: End-to-end test script for the three newly identified weak signals (permission_scope, temporal_stability, tool_description_safety). Tests that new enrichment modules produce at least 20 distinct scores across synthetic corpus. Verifies signal_analyser reads from mcp_signal_enrichments table and passes data to trust_synthesiser with correct signal_type names. Asserts composite score changes when enrichment scores vary. This is a library test, not a daemon.
